QuestInfo.name: Growing a Sprout
QuestInfo.0: #bCassandra#k is handing out a pretty Pot. Head over to #bCassandra#k.
QuestInfo.1: The sprout in the Pot grows every time you hunt, but she says it'll grow even faster if you double-click the Pot and let it receive sunlight.
QuestInfo.2: You have delivered a Pot to #bCassandra#k.
